$schema_note: v2 reference for the basal population-phenotype report card. Axes carry presentation + a TYPED criterion. Population-stat axes grade by Welch t-test of candidate per-cell values vs these blessed reference values (cell-level n). A SIGNIFICANT difference (p<p_min) is drift/mismatch. Self-pin => p=1.0 at baseline; future drift / PDMP lowers p. Judgement is deferred: the pin is current main's behavior, not a biological target.
title: Basal-condition population phenotype — v1↔v2 equivalence (Physiology + Composition)

stimulus.ensemble: 2 seeds x 2 gens (smoke); vEcoli master; ParCa fast

findings: EQUIVALENCE reference: v2ecoli graded against a vEcoli v1 ensemble (not a self-pin). Welch t-test of v2 cell-level values vs v1 ref_values.
Phase-1 scope: Physiology + Composition. Ribosomes/fluxes/omics omitted (vEcoli emits bulk positionally, not as bulk__id/bulk__count; needs the bulk-index adapter).
v1 values read by scripts/pin_vecoli_equivalence_reference.py (self-contained cross-impl reader; shared analysis_runner is untouched).
tolerance bands (within_pct/mismatch_pct) inherited from the self-pin template; revisit per-axis equivalence margins (delta) for the real run.

physiology.doubling_time.label: Doubling time
physiology.doubling_time.how: Cell-cycle time over confirmed divisions (one value per divided cell). Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis_runner.py::build_cell_records.

physiology.cell_mass.label: Cell mass
physiology.cell_mass.how: Time-mean total cell mass (listeners__mass__cell_mass), one value/cell. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis_runner.py::build_cell_records.

physiology.cell_volume.label: Cell volume
physiology.cell_volume.how: Time-mean cell volume (listeners__mass__volume), one value/cell. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis_runner.py::build_cell_records.

physiology.oric.label: Replication origins (oriC)
physiology.oric.how: Time-mean number_of_oric — >1 indicates overlapping replication rounds. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis_runner.py::build_cell_records.

physiology.replication_initiation.label: Replication initiation
physiology.replication_initiation.how: Per-cell time since birth of the first oriC step-up (a new round fires). Absent for cells born between rounds that don't re-initiate in-cycle. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis_runner.py::build_cell_records.

physiology.replication_completion.label: Replication completion
physiology.replication_completion.how: Per-cell time since birth when replication forks first clear (a round terminates). NOTE: under overlapping rounds this tracks a DIFFERENT round than initiation above — they are not one round's start/end. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis_runner.py::build_cell_records.

composition.protein_fraction.label: Protein / dry weight
composition.protein_fraction.how: Time-mean protein mass fraction of dry weight. One value per cell (gens≥3); population stats across the 20 cells. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis.py::PopulationPhenotypeBasalCard.

composition.rna_fraction.label: Total RNA / dry weight
composition.rna_fraction.how: Time-mean total-RNA (rRna+tRna+mRna) mass fraction of dry weight. One value per cell (gens≥3); population stats across the 20 cells. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis.py::PopulationPhenotypeBasalCard.

composition.dna_fraction.label: DNA / dry weight
composition.dna_fraction.how: Time-mean DNA mass fraction of dry weight. One value per cell (gens≥3); population stats across the 20 cells. Source: v2ecoli/workflow/analysis.py::PopulationPhenotypeBasalCard.
